title: UK CPI, March 2027 (ONS, 07:00 London / 02:00 ET) — the last drag-in print, and the endpoint every claim about the April step is measured against
source: EST: ons.gov.uk/releases/consumerpriceinflationukmarch2027, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200) — the ONS release page reads 'Consumer price inflation, UK: March 2027', '21 April 2027 7:00am', is labelled 'Provisional', and states 'This release is not yet published'. Filed estimate on ONS's own Provisional label, on this lane's no-self-confirm limit, and because market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy (IR:/CAL:/BLS:/FED:/PJM:/SEC:/TSY:/OCC:/BEA:/CENSUS:/ISM:/CB:/UMICH:/FHFA:) has no slot for the UK Office for National Statistics. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of uk-cpi-2027-05-19, 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED BY THE uk-cpi-2027-05-19 LANE, 2026-09-09, because a step needs two endpoints and only one was on the calendar. This is the MARCH 2027 print -- the LAST month inside the SI 2026/987 zero-rate window (supplies made 1 October 2026 to 31 March 2027) and therefore the last print carrying the electricity VAT drag. Every statement in uk-electricity-vat-reversion-2027-04-01 and uk-cpi-2027-05-19 about the April step is a statement about THIS print versus the next one: the drag is in here and out of the 2027-05-19 print, and the difference is the roughly 0.081-0.129pp the whole entry exists to attribute. Without it diarised, the April claim has a floating baseline. IT ALSO LANDS IN A SEQUENCING GAP WORTH KEEPING: it publishes on 2027-04-21, twenty days AFTER the 2027-04-01 lapse but describing a month entirely BEFORE it, and eight days BEFORE the 2027-04-29 MPC + Monetary Policy Report that must publish a forecast embedding the reversion having seen no post-lapse data. So this is the last hard inflation datapoint that committee gets, and it is one that structurally cannot contain the thing it has to forecast. WHAT A RESEARCHER SHOULD NOT DO WITH IT: read a soft March 2027 electricity number as evidence about pass-through. The drag is a level effect that has been in the index since October 2026 and is flat by then; the observable event is the April month-on-month move, in the NEXT print. A SECOND, INDEPENDENT REASON THIS DATE IS AWKWARD: Easter Sunday 2027 is 28 March (computus), so the March 2027 print contains Easter while March 2026 did not (Easter 2026 was 5 April) -- the air-fares and package-holiday base effect that the proposing lane sized at -0.075pp to +0.144pp of headline from air fares alone (D7EH, weight CJXW 5.2374/1000, April swings of -14.3% to +27.4% over 2015-2026) lands HERE with the opposite sign to the one it carries in the April print. A reader comparing the two consecutive prints is looking at a VAT step and an Easter reversal moving in opposite directions across the same pair of months. Tiered LOW: symbols: [], no UK listing, gilt or sterling instrument on this calendar, and the whole tracked universe is eight US mega-caps. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
